_why: Ids of people the archive does not publish at all: possible minors, under the estate's living-people standard v2 (16 October 2026). By id and never by name.
A held-out person has no page, is nobody's relative here, and has no entry in site/src/data/person-slugs.json. Recomputed by tools/living_v2.py on every build.
rule: not recorded dead, no public-source citation, and under 18 by year, or no birth year and a living parent
